review:
One of Wazdan's oddest layouts: one main reel surrounded by smaller ones, with an Asian prosperity theme. Magic Coins on the corner reels switch on extra reels, so the play area grows as you spin.

The Ox Bonus runs on 25 reels with a 2,500x Grand. Extra Lives can add up to three more spins after your respins run out, which really matters in a round like this. High volatility, 96.21% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
